title: Hubba
desc: Hubba Shyamal, a notorious gangster from the West Bengal town of Konnagar, delves into a variety of criminal activities and even makes a foray into politics.

desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Arpan
desc: Anil loves Shobha and hopes to marry her. When he goes abroad for a year, he leaves her in charge of his family but upon his return, he is shell-shocked to learn that she has married someone else.

title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Raj Sinha, a policeman, kills gangster Durjo Rai's son in an encounter. He soon asks Abhimanyu, a suspended colleague, to protect the last two members of his family from Rai.

title: Mahajan
desc: A powerful landowner conducts his business and lives his life with cruelty. However, various circumstances influence him to change his nature and tactics over time.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.
